newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sends team to site of peasant killings.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sends team to site of peasant killings.

text.p: Doctors and investigators were headed on Wednesday to a farm in Para state where farmhands gunned down at least three peasant squatters, officials said.
A spokeswoman for Gov. Almir Gabriel said the death toll could rise from the conflict, which occurred on Monday in the Amazonian state near the township of Ourilandia do Norte.

"The information we have so far is that three squatters were killed. We should find out later today, after the team arrives, if more than that died," she told Reuters by telephone from the state capital Belem.
Newspapers reported that as many as 20 people might have been killed, which would make the clash the bloodiest so far in a recent wave of violence in Brazil's countryside.

The south of Para, a violent and poorly policed area, has emerged as a flashpoint in the conflict between landowners and squatters inspired by Brazil's militant Landless Movement. The movement has organised invasions of large estates.
